title: Ulku's Giant Eraser PROBLEM!
description: Eli the eraser tries to 'help' Saf's science project... and erases the WHOLE thing 🤣 #ThePenFamily #Shorts
thumbnail_prompt: Saf (purple pen, shocked face) standing in front of a blank paper that used to have her project. Eli (red eraser) looking guilty next to her. Bright school classroom background. No text.

beats.text: WHAT HAPPENED TO MY PROJECT?!
Don't worry! I fixed the smudges!
You erased EVERYTHING. It's due TODAY.
Oops. Let me help fix it!
You CANNOT help. You're an eraser!
Whoa. That paper is very clean.
Okay this is actually a great video though.
Bas PLEASE not now!
Mistakes happen! Can I write it back?
Erasers can't WRITE, Eli!
I can draw a volcano!
It's a project on gravity! Why a volcano?!
Volcanos have gravity. Maybe.
Tell the teacher the eraser did it.
Nobody will believe that!
I'll go talk to the teacher myself!
An eraser confessing to a teacher — content.
Eli. You need to ask before you help.
...I should've asked first. Didn't think.
Yay!
